name: Charles Frederick Worth
bio: English couturier in Paris. He founded the first modern fashion house and dressed the Second Empire court in the cage crinoline and then the bustle.

milestones.event: Opened the House of Worth at 7 rue de la Paix, Paris, with Otto Bobergh.
Became the dressmaker of Empress Eugénie after Princess Pauline de Metternich presented him.
